title: Match capitals: Oceania
intro: Match each country in Oceania with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Suva is the capital of Fiji.
Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).
Tarawa is the capital of Kiribati.
Majuro is the capital of Marshall Islands.
Melekeok is the capital of Palau.
Honiara is the capital of Solomon Islands.
Funafuti is the capital of Tuvalu.
Apia is the capital of Samoa.
